mechanism: oracle fixture v2 (task-zone-unwedge, 2026-09-05): identical spatial repair to oracle_zone_clear.json, plus an ADVERTISED-ONLY wedge lane. Measured cause it targets: z1/z3 freeze at n_closed=185/305 AFTER the spatial repair succeeds (:translated), and the nominal loop's unwedge hook (demo_utils.jl:273 -> maybe_unwedge_nominal!) can only fire ONCE, because UNWEDGE_INTERVAL defaults to 2000 while the no-progress watchdog terminates at 3000. One firing enters recover_stalled_teams! with SNAP_COUNT=0, so the escalation rungs gated on SNAP_ESCALATE_AT=3 are unreachable. This body lowers the interval with the ADVERTISED set_unwedge_interval! so the existing nominal machinery gets ~7 tries instead of 1, and calls the ADVERTISED reform_stuck_teams! once itself. The three withheld verbs (recover_stalled_teams!, resolve_schedule_wedge!, force_advance_stuck_carrier!) are still NOT named here - they are reached, if at all, only through the nominal hook that every run already has. This is a control for 'does the ADVERTISED vocabulary suffice', not a design change.

function OracleZoneClearU!(env)
    zk = [k for (k, _) in active_restriction_zones()]
    isempty(zk) && return (; status = :no_zone)
    st = restage_all_blocked!(env; zone_keys = zk, resume = true, verbose = true)
    stage = :restage
    fin = st.status
    if st.status !== :restaged_all
        tw = translate_whole_build!(env; zone_keys = zk, resume = true, verbose = true)
        stage = :translate
        fin = tw.status
    end
    set_unwedge_interval!(400)
    n = reform_stuck_teams!(env; min_ready = 1)
    return (; status = fin, stage = stage, restage_status = st.status,
             n_moved = length(st.moved), n_zones = length(zk),
             n_reformed = n, unwedge_interval = 400)
end
